4574-6495-6900-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
4574-6495-6900-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
628-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-4871-5695-6019.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from steps 3 and 7
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

851-4365-4772-4826-7942.description:

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4399-4770-6626-7399.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6626-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2155-5147-7124.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2155-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

856-2034-4321-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2034-4321-7396.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1636-2292-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Intruder Alarm triggers three times. Resolve the Intruder Alarm triggers from this step and step 2, untapping all creatures four times.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-6968-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3215-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast Bloodline Pretender by paying {3}.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodline Pretender.
When Bloodline Pretender dies, Haru triggers, returning Bloodline Pretender from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bloodline Pretender enters, Haru triggers, targeting Bloodline Pretender as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3750-7017-7019.easyPrerequisites: You and an opponent each control a creature.
3750-7017-7019.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Zuko.
You have at least five experience counters.
3750-7017-7019.description:
Cast The Last Agni Kai by paying {1}{R}.
Declare Zuko as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of experience counters you have.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to The Last Agni Kai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2499-5967-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-5967-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-5967-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

826-2178-5256-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5070-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5070-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

589-1786-2919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-1786-2919.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1242-2144-6723.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 until Cinderhaze Wretch dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Myrkul triggers, causing you to exile Cinderhaze Wretch and create a token copy of Cinderhaze Wretch that is an enchantment and loses all other card types.
Activate the Cinderhaze Wretch token by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate the Cinderhaze Wretch token's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

224-765-1772-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

645-1267-2292-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2292-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

428-1694-1844-2719.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
428-1694-1844-2719.description:

Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

4231-4321-5270-5682-5686.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Astrid.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

222-2018-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 6.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an ability from Goblin Bombardment is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two of the artifact tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's  Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1652-2136-2816-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Orthion.
1652-2136-2816-4050.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Patron of the Arts with haste.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing the Patron of the Arts tokens, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
When the Patron of the Arts tokens die, they trigger, creating five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}.
Activate Orthion by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.

678-4231-4634.description:
Cast Wavesifter for its evoke cost by paying {G}{U}.
Wavesifter enters the battlefield and is immediately sacrificed, triggering Wavesifter and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Wavesifter trigger, creating two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Wavesifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{U}.

413-2073-3698-3764.notablePrerequisites: You have a noncreature artifact card in your graveyard with mana value one or less.
413-2073-3698-3764.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning any noncreature artifact with mana value one or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The artifact enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Pincher.
The Pincher dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
